title: Backend Infrastructure Upgrade
summary: Migrated to Google's new Places API (New) for improved reliability and future-proofing. All API calls now securely handled on the backend.
improvements: Upgraded to Google Places API (New): Modern API with better performance and features
Enhanced security: API keys now securely stored on backend instead of frontend
Environment variables: Backend now loads .env file for easier configuration
Better error handling: More detailed logging for API-related issues
fixes: Fixed API key restrictions preventing restaurant search
Resolved IPv6 compatibility issues with Google Places API
Corrected field mask requirements for new Places API endpoints

title: Streamlined Search & Performance
summary: Improved restaurant search experience with unified filtering and cleaner production builds for better performance.
features: Unified search results: Google Places results now merge with saved restaurants and filter together
Auto-dismiss notifications: Success messages automatically disappear after 3 seconds
Production-ready logging: Console logs now silent in production, active only in development
improvements: Simplified search interface: Single filter input now works for all restaurants (saved + new)
Cleaner console: Production builds no longer output debug logs for better performance
Better UX: Google Places search shows floating success notification instead of static banner
Removed duplicate filter: Eliminated redundant search input after location searches
fixes: Restaurant filtering now applies to combined results from all sources
Clear Search Results button properly resets notification state

title: Enhanced Search, Pagination & UI Improvements
summary: Major updates including visit search, traditional pagination for restaurant discovery, expanded food establishment types, and numerous UI/UX improvements.
features: Search your visits: Find visits by restaurant name, location, food items, or notes
Traditional pagination: Navigate restaurant results with page numbers (<< < 1 2 3 4 5 > >>)
Expanded food places: Search now includes cafes, bakeries, coffee shops, dessert shops, ice cream shops, and more
What's New dialog: Automatic notification on app updates (shows once per version)
Quick add button: 'Add Your First Visit' button when you have no visits yet
improvements: Feedback button moved to header for easier access (removed floating button)
Settings page footer now visible for consistent navigation
Real-time feedback notification badge updates immediately when marking as read
Search visits auto-expands all matching months for better visibility
Restaurant search covers larger radius (5km) to find more options
Search inputs remain visible after getting results for easy refinement
Clear visual feedback for search results with result count
fixes: Settings back button now correctly returns to Profile page (not Home)
Feedback notification badge updates immediately after reading messages
Fixed search functionality to include all food establishment types
Pagination properly resets when starting a new search

title: Welcome to Track Your Foods
summary: The initial release brings you a comprehensive food tracking experience with social features, location-based restaurant search, and privacy controls.
features: Track restaurant visits with ratings, notes, and photos
Find nearby restaurants using Google Places API with GPS and manual location search
Rate food items with 5-star system ("Don't eat ever" to "Eat often")
Upload menu photos and use OCR scanning to extract menu items automatically
Add friends via QR codes or friend codes to share your food experiences
View friends' visits on your home feed (respecting privacy settings)
Control visit visibility - share with friends or keep private
Submit feedback and feature requests directly in the app
Invite-only system - first user can generate invite codes for friends
Chronological home feed grouped by month and day
Search restaurants by name, location, or cuisine type
Edit or delete your visits anytime
Customize profile with name and manage account settings
